summary: Apex Critical Metals, a Canadian-listed mineral explorer (CSE: APXC, OTCQX: APXCF), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 8, 2026 press release reporting Phase II drill assays from its 100%-owned Rift Rare Earth Project in southeastern Nebraska. Step-out hole RIFT26-019 returned 197.5 m at 2.12% REO, including 26.9 m at 3.15% REO, extending the Trinity Zone about 120 m down-dip west; three southern-fence holes added roughly 100 m of strike. No transaction terms, consideration, premium, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. An inaugural mineral resource estimate is targeted for Q1 2027; watch exploration-risk and pending western assays.
